summary: Verified the fix for 'ReferenceError: restaurant is not defined' in DashboardPage.jsx. Line 178 destructures settings from useRestaurant(), and line 454 now uses settings?.keyboardShortcuts. In RestaurantContext, settings is a memo of restaurant?.settings || defaults, so the fix behaves the same as the original intent. ESLint with no-undef found 0 errors in DashboardPage.jsx. The served dev bundle contains the fixed code ('settings !== null && ... settings.keyboardShortcuts'). The webpack build compiles with 1 unrelated warning. The login page (from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) renders correctly: all testids are present, there is no ErrorBoundary and there are 0 console or page errors. Other places that use restaurant?.settings (OrderEntry.jsx, CollectPaymentPanel.jsx) destructure restaurant correctly. The post-login dashboard was NOT tested in the browser because no credentials are available (the auth API is external at preprod.mygenie.online).
action_items: Optional: run the full post-login dashboard flow once preprod credentials are added to /app/memory/test_credentials.md
critical_code_review_comments: DashboardPage.jsx is very large (>1800 lines); consider splitting it
There are no project-level no-undef lint gates in CI; adding eslint no-undef as an error would have caught this bug at build time
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix verified at code, lint and bundle level, and on the login page. Post-login DashboardPage render is untested because there are no credentials.
